newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Showa Shell-Mitsubishi merger decision maybe Q3.
newsitem.headline: Showa Shell-Mitsubishi merger decision maybe Q3.

text.p: A decision on a proposed oil refining and distribution merger between Showa Shell Sekiyu KK and Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd might be reached in six months, a Showa Shell official said on Monday.

"I think it could take six months to make a decision" on the merger, said Kazuhisa Hayashi, manager of Showa Shell's Change Promotion Center. He stressed that he was not directly involved in the talks.
"Both companies are examining the possibility and are conducting a feasibility study," he told Reuters after addressing a seminar in Kuwait.

The merger is aimed at reducing distribution and refining costs as part of restructuring by Japanese oil firms which are facing financial difficulties due to Tokoyo's deregulation of oil product imports last April. Further tariff reductions are due next April.
Showa Shell's Managing Director Mitsuaki Nabetani said last month his firm and Mitsubishi were "exchanging information" on the possible merger which he described as one of many options.
